product.name: Awareness & Phishing Simulation
product.description: A service to assess employee readiness through realistic phishing simulations and launch awareness campaigns.

product.name: GRC Consulting
product.description: Consulting services offering full assessment and implementation of governance, risk, and compliance programs.

product.name: Managed Awareness

product.description: Assistance in achieving compliance certification for local and international standards.
